email-structure-subject-greeting-closing.description: Business email greetings and closings with examples: subject line, polite opening, short body, sign-off and signature. Sample emails included.

addFaqs.q: What are good greetings and closings for a business email?
addFaqs.a: For a greeting, use Dear Mr Sharma when you know the name, Dear Hiring Manager when you do not, and Hello Priya or Hi Priya for a friendly, neutral tone. For a closing, Kind regards is neutral and safe, Best regards is friendlier, and Yours sincerely is formal when you used the person's name.

chat-messages-teams-whatsapp-etiquette.description: Business chat etiquette for Teams, Slack and WhatsApp: write clear messages, use emojis sensibly, respect working hours and time zones, and know when to call.

addFaqs.a: It is a set of simple habits for work chat: put your question in the first message, keep messages short and polite, reply even with a quick thanks, use emojis only where they fit, respect working hours and time zones, keep private matters out of group chats, and move to email or a call when the topic needs it.
